data.text: Thanks. Please use the cell first for any result callbacks unless that fails.

prior_context.text: I have not missed any morning doses. I might have been late by a few hours last Monday night when I was changing locations, but I still took that pill before bed.

prior_context.text: I will document that as possible delayed but not skipped Monday-night dose. Any completely missed doses in the last three weeks?

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: Good. What about alcohol, supplements, or stimulants that could affect rhythm?

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: No energy drinks. I am focusing on recovery and do not want those details discussed with family.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: I hear you. I will keep family updates limited to the logistics scope you set.

prior_context.speaker: agent_memcare
prior_context.text: Nursing intake summary: symptomatic atrial fibrillation/flutter with exertional dyspnea and lightheadedness, no active bleeding, possible delayed Monday-night apixaban dose but no confirmed skipped dose, ibuprofen used last week and should be reviewed.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: I am getting your vitals now. Heart rate is 128, blood pressure 132 over 86, oxygen 98 percent on room air.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: I am placing orders for CBC, BMP, magnesium, TSH, and a repeat ECG before Dr. Patel comes in.

prior_context.speaker: labtech_mira
prior_context.text: I have the tubes labeled. Marcus, I am drawing blood now and the results should be back before the cardiologist finalizes the plan.
